summary: Kestrel Insight Partners offers a 45-minute call with a former advanced packaging engineer who worked on Nvidia's capacity plan. The call is on Wednesday, Oct 14 at 8:00am ET, and two seats remain.
why_attention: Seats are released to other clients unless someone confirms by 4:00pm ET today, so a person must decide whether to take one.
